title: Error-Corrected Memory and Logic on a Heavy-Hex Superconducting-Qubit Processor
summary: Large quantum computations require high-fidelity error-corrected memory and fault-tolerant logical operations. To achieve these with superconducting circuits, quantum processors will need many components operating with low error rates. In practice, fabrication of monolithic superconducting devices produces unavoidable heterogeneity in component performance, which the quantum computer must accommodate.
